## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tried it in the local preview (`npm run dev:demo`), with screenshots for visual changes
- [ ] Every page still works with JavaScript turned off (image uploads excepted)
- [ ] New schema changes are in a new `migrations/000N_….sql` file
- [ ] README or CHANGELOG updated if people will notice the change

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the house rules (security, plain language, free-plan limits, no review gating).
